status: proposed, 2026-10-09. Pre-registered in design/PART11A_ENERGY_REFERENCES.md before any deciding evidence
design_sha256_pin: DESIGN_SHA256 in energy_reference.py and design_sha256 in the suite config. Integrity only. The hash shows the file is unchanged, not when it was written.
qualification: implementation equations and the declared label model only. No atmospheric, EDMF, radiation-physics or eight-tag qualification
representation: native density cell averages on unit-area cells

profile_rules.source: the scorer's approved numbers, imported by energy_reference.py. Repeated here for the record only
profile_rules.theta_x_window: [0, endpoint], proposed 2026-10-09 for these fixtures only
profile_rules.record_tolerance: none approved (EA-ACCURACY). Record floors are reported in J m^-2 and never scored

cases.identity: dot a_k = w_kp max(delta_p, 0) with delta_p = S_p > 0. Region tags start at M_k E_c(0)
cases.independent_mechanism: closed-form labelled reservoirs and a separate step allocator

convention.basis: the convention of the previous runs, a historical baseline chosen for this fixture. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.contract_row: G4_CLAIM_CONTRACTS 6, row 2. Equation 2.2, loss by phi_k
cases.identity: a_k(t) = a_k(0) E_c(t) / E_c(0) for pure donor loss with positive E_c and no other term
cases.independent_mechanism: closed-form exponential cooling and a separate step allocator with clamped shares

convention.basis: c_p,d T_0, the alternative recorded in G4.10. A second value shows that each case declares its own c. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.contract_row: G4_CLAIM_CONTRACTS 6, row 3. Equation 2.3, transport share psi_k
cases.identity: dot a_k = -div(F_c psi_donor,k) with two gross face flows, each with a known donor, in positive-share conditions
cases.independent_mechanism: closed-form two-reservoir exchange and a separate forward-Euler donor allocator

convention.basis: the historical baseline, chosen for this fixture. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.contract_row: G4_CLAIM_CONTRACTS 6, row 4. Equation 2.3 with F_c = F_E + c F_M
cases.identity: Delta E_c = Delta(rho e_tot) + c Delta rho, with falling mass of negative E_c carried upward. The energy donor follows the sign of F_c
cases.independent_mechanism: prescribed face fluxes, closed-form labels and a separate step allocator

convention.basis: the historical baseline. F_c is upward only while e_fall + c < 0, so this case holds for c below 3e5 J/kg. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.surface_donor: bottom cell, proposed 2026-10-09 (the contract leaves the surface donor to verification)
cases.mass_is_water: only for the sedimentation flux. The water-only forcing changes rho q and not rho

cases.identity: Distinct +Q and -Q events. The heating overlay obeys dot a = Q - (a/E_c) Q, so a = E_c (1 - exp(-Q t / E_c)). Records +Q t and -Q t
cases.independent_mechanism: closed form and a separate sequential-event allocator. Application activity, Theta_x and Theta_i are computed separately

convention.basis: the historical baseline, chosen for this fixture. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.identity: Delta E_c = Delta(rho e_tot) + c Delta rho on a bitwise identical parent. The mass source changes sign in E_c between the two conventions
cases.independent_mechanism: closed form at each c. A pure representation test, not an independent provenance reference

convention.basis: the c and 2c pair of E71 and E87. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.identity: phi = clamp(a / E_c, 0, 1) where E_c > 0, else zero share and an undefined origin. Region claims need positive signed inventory. Cancelling corrections keep their application activity
cases.independent_mechanism: an independent classifier of each cell, tag and correction sequence

convention.basis: the historical baseline. Cell 2 has E_c = 0 exactly at this c only. Proposed 2026-10-09

cases.contract_row: G4_CLAIM_CONTRACTS 6, row 8. Section 2.4 and the record row of section 5
cases.identity: P(t) = integral of -D_z F_rad with the stepper's stage weights. Window amount rho(t1) e_prc(t1) - rho(t0) e_prc(t0)
cases.independent_mechanism: face-flux time integrals first, then the divergence and the boundary integral. The continuum record is closed form

convention.basis: inapplicable. A record carries delta_p^rho e alone, without c delta_p^rho (section 2.4)
